  function degenerateCamera15801(anchor,zoom){
    const lat=Number(anchor&&anchor.lat),lng=Number(anchor&&anchor.lng),z=Number(zoom);
    if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lng)||!Number.isFinite(z))return true;
    // Exact integer-pair centers are common startup/fallback signatures, not
    // defensible property targets. This is intentionally narrow to avoid
    // rejecting legitimate coordinates merely near a round number.
    const integerPair=
      Math.abs(lat-Math.round(lat))<1e-7&&
      Math.abs(lng-Math.round(lng))<1e-7;
    return integerPair;
  }

  function authoritativeSwaleData15792(){

  function syncLivingSwales15792(data,force=false){

    const signature=[
      M&&M.searchGen,
      fc.features.length,
      fc.features.map(f=>

    const sourceChanged=!!src&&src!==lastSwaleSource15799;

              // Mapbox source.
              if(
                src&&src.setData&&
                (force||committedProperty||sourceChanged||signature!==lastSwaleSignature)
              ){

  function authoritativeSwaleData15792(){
    const regional=window.earthlineRegional15778||{};
    const propertyMode=!!(
      M&&M.analysisReady&&regional.mode==="property"&&!regional.active
    );

    if(propertyMode){
      const verified=!!(
        M.propertyResultLock15815&&M.propertyResultLock15815.safetyVerified===true&&
        M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified===true
      );
      if(
        verified&&M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815&&
        M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.type==="FeatureCollection"
      )return safeData(M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815);
      return emptyFC();
    }

    if(regional.active&&regional.swales){
      return safeData(regional.swales);
    }

    const legacySource=earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getSource&&
      earthlineMap.getSource(LEGACY_SWALE_SOURCE);
    if(legacySource&&legacySource._data){
      const legacy=safeData(legacySource._data);
      if(legacy.features.length)return legacy;
    }

    return emptyFC();
  }
  function syncLivingSwales15792(data,force=false){
    if(!ensureLayers15792()){
      M.livingSwaleRenderer15792={
        features:0,visible:false,source:SWALE_SOURCE,
        legacyHidden:true,reason:"map-style-not-ready"
      };
      return false;
    }

    const regional=window.earthlineRegional15778||{};
    const committedProperty=!!(
      M&&M.analysisReady&&
      regional.mode==="property"&&!regional.active&&
      M.propertyPublication15816&&
      M.propertyPublication15816.committed===true
    );
    const committedData=(
      committedProperty&&
      M.propertyResultLock15815&&M.propertyResultLock15815.safetyVerified===true&&
      M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified===true&&
      M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815&&
      M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.type==="FeatureCollection"&&
      Array.isArray(M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.features)
    )
      ?M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815
      :null;

    // A committed property result always outranks data supplied by the legacy
    // source interceptor. This prevents a later empty legacy update from
    // erasing the accepted prescription.
    const fc=safeData(committedData||data||authoritativeSwaleData15792());
    const signature=[
      M&&M.searchGen,
      fc.features.length,
      fc.features.map(f=>
        f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates&&
        f.geometry.coordinates.length||0
      ).join(",")
    ].join("|");

    const src=earthlineMap.getSource(SWALE_SOURCE);
    const sourceChanged=!!src&&src!==lastSwaleSource15799;
    if(sourceChanged)lastSwaleSource15799=src;

    // A committed result is small and must be republished on every authoritative
              // refresh. Signature caching is not allowed to conceal an externally emptied
              // Mapbox source.
              if(
                src&&src.setData&&
                (force||committedProperty||sourceChanged||signature!==lastSwaleSignature)
              ){
                lastSwaleSignature=signature;
                lastSwaleData=fc;
                src.setData(fc);
              }

    if(typeof window.earthlineSyncNaturalSwalePlanting15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineSyncNaturalSwalePlanting15806(fc);
    }

    const toggle=!!(
      M&&M.layers&&M.layers.swales&&M.layers.swales.on
    );
    const show=toggle&&fc.features.length>0;

    for(const id of [
      SWALE_GLOW,SWALE_EARTH,SWALE_LIFE,SWALE_WATER
    ])layerVisible(id,show);

    if(typeof window.earthlineSetNaturalSwalePlantingVisible15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineSetNaturalSwalePlantingVisible15806(show);
    }

    hideLegacySwales();
    M.livingSwaleRenderer15792={
      build:"BUILD-CHECK-15817",
      features:fc.features.length,
      visible:show,
      source:SWALE_SOURCE,
      sourceReady:!!src,
      committedProperty,
      legacyHidden:true,
      safetyVetted:!!(
        M&&M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified
      ),
      acceptedIntersections:M&&M.safetyAudit15806
        ?M.safetyAudit15806.acceptedIntersections:null,
      deliveredAt:Date.now()
    };

    if(typeof window.earthlineRenderSafetyPanel15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineRenderSafetyPanel15806();
    }
    return show;
  }

  function authoritativeSwaleData15792(){
    const regional=window.earthlineRegional15778||{};
    const propertyMode=!!(
      M&&M.analysisReady&&regional.mode==="property"&&!regional.active
    );

    if(propertyMode){
      const verified=!!(
        M.propertyResultLock15815&&M.propertyResultLock15815.safetyVerified===true&&
        M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified===true
      );
      if(
        verified&&M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815&&
        M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.type==="FeatureCollection"
      )return safeData(M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815);
      return emptyFC();
    }

    if(regional.active&&regional.swales){
      return safeData(regional.swales);
    }

    const legacySource=earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getSource&&
      earthlineMap.getSource(LEGACY_SWALE_SOURCE);
    if(legacySource&&legacySource._data){
      const legacy=safeData(legacySource._data);
      if(legacy.features.length)return legacy;
    }

    return emptyFC();
  }
  function syncLivingSwales15792(data,force=false){
    if(!ensureLayers15792()){
      M.livingSwaleRenderer15792={
        features:0,visible:false,source:SWALE_SOURCE,
        legacyHidden:true,reason:"map-style-not-ready"
      };
      return false;
    }

    const regional=window.earthlineRegional15778||{};
    const committedProperty=!!(
      M&&M.analysisReady&&
      regional.mode==="property"&&!regional.active&&
      M.propertyPublication15816&&
      M.propertyPublication15816.committed===true
    );
    const committedData=(
      committedProperty&&
      M.propertyResultLock15815&&M.propertyResultLock15815.safetyVerified===true&&
      M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified===true&&
      M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815&&
      M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.type==="FeatureCollection"&&
      Array.isArray(M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815.features)
    )
      ?M.authoritativeSafeSwales15815
      :null;

    // A committed property result always outranks data supplied by the legacy
    // source interceptor. This prevents a later empty legacy update from
    // erasing the accepted prescription.
    const fc=safeData(committedData||data||authoritativeSwaleData15792());
    const signature=[
      M&&M.searchGen,
      fc.features.length,
      fc.features.map(f=>
        f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates&&
        f.geometry.coordinates.length||0
      ).join(",")
    ].join("|");

    const src=earthlineMap.getSource(SWALE_SOURCE);
    const sourceChanged=!!src&&src!==lastSwaleSource15799;
    if(sourceChanged)lastSwaleSource15799=src;

    // A committed result is small and must be republished on every authoritative
              // refresh. Signature caching is not allowed to conceal an externally emptied
              // Mapbox source.
              if(
                src&&src.setData&&
                (force||committedProperty||sourceChanged||signature!==lastSwaleSignature)
              ){
                lastSwaleSignature=signature;
                lastSwaleData=fc;
                src.setData(fc);
              }

    if(typeof window.earthlineSyncNaturalSwalePlanting15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineSyncNaturalSwalePlanting15806(fc);
    }

    const toggle=!!(
      M&&M.layers&&M.layers.swales&&M.layers.swales.on
    );
    const show=toggle&&fc.features.length>0;

    for(const id of [
      SWALE_GLOW,SWALE_EARTH,SWALE_LIFE,SWALE_WATER
    ])layerVisible(id,show);

    if(typeof window.earthlineSetNaturalSwalePlantingVisible15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineSetNaturalSwalePlantingVisible15806(show);
    }

    hideLegacySwales();
    M.livingSwaleRenderer15792={
      build:"BUILD-CHECK-15817",
      features:fc.features.length,
      visible:show,
      source:SWALE_SOURCE,
      sourceReady:!!src,
      committedProperty,
      legacyHidden:true,
      safetyVetted:!!(
        M&&M.safetyAudit15806&&M.safetyAudit15806.verified
      ),
      acceptedIntersections:M&&M.safetyAudit15806
        ?M.safetyAudit15806.acceptedIntersections:null,
      deliveredAt:Date.now()
    };

    if(typeof window.earthlineRenderSafetyPanel15806==="function"){
      window.earthlineRenderSafetyPanel15806();
    }
    return show;
  }

  function installLegacyCapture15792(){
    if(!mapReady())return false;
    const src=earthlineMap.getSource(LEGACY_SWALE_SOURCE);
    if(!src||src===wrappedLegacySource||src.__earthline15792)return !!src;
    const prior=src.setData&&src.setData.bind(src);
    if(!prior)return false;
    try{
      src.setData=function(data){
        const out=prior(data);
        const regional=window.earthlineRegional15778||{};
        const committedProperty=!!(
          M&&M.analysisReady&&
          regional.mode==="property"&&!regional.active&&
          M.propertyPublication15816&&
          M.propertyPublication15816.committed===true
        );
        if(committedProperty){
          syncLivingSwales15792(undefined,true);
        }else{
          const filtered=safeData(src._data||data);
          syncLivingSwales15792(filtered,true);
        }
        hideLegacySwales();
        return out;
      };
      src.__earthline15792=true;
      wrappedLegacySource=src;
      return true;
    }catch(e){
      console.warn("[Earthline] "+BUILD+" source capture",e);
      return false;
    }
  }

  function bufferedRing(coords,halfWidth=4.5){if(!Array.isArray(coords)||coords.length<2)return null;const xy=coords.map(mercatorXY),left=[],right=[];for(let i=0;i<xy.length;i++){const prev=xy[Math.max(0,i-1)],cur=xy[i],next=xy[Math.min(xy.length-1,i+1)],d1=unit(cur[0]-prev[0],cur[1]-prev[1]),d2=unit(next[0]-cur[0],next[1]-cur[1]);let tx=d1[0]+d2[0],ty=d1[1]+d2[1];if(Math.hypot(tx,ty)<.001){tx=d2[0]||d1[0];ty=d2[1]||d1[1]}const t=unit(tx,ty),n=[-t[1],t[0]],n1=[-d1[1],d1[0]],den=Math.max(.28,Math.abs(n[0]*n1[0]+n[1]*n1[1])),m=Math.min(halfWidth*2.4,halfWidth/den);left.push(mercatorLL([cur[0]+n[0]*m,cur[1]+n[1]*m]));right.push(mercatorLL([cur[0]-n[0]*m,cur[1]-n[1]*m]))}const ring=[...left,...right.reverse()];if(ring.length<4)return null;ring.push(ring[0]);return ring}

  /* EARTHLINE 16529 — pre-analysis mapped-open-water gate. This is intentionally
     outside the scientific engine: it reads only map data already loaded under the
     selected crosshair and either declines the Property run or leaves 16521 untouched. */
  function earthlinePointInRing16529(lng,lat,ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return false;
    let inside=false;
    for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
      const a=ring[i],b=ring[j];
      const xi=Number(a&&a[0]),yi=Number(a&&a[1]),xj=Number(b&&b[0]),yj=Number(b&&b[1]);
      if(![xi,yi,xj,yj].every(Number.isFinite))continue;
      if(((yi>lat)!==(yj>lat))&&(lng<(xj-xi)*(lat-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-12)+xi))inside=!inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }

      if(bounded.length>=320)break;
    }
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.featureCount=bounded.length;
    for(let n=0;n<bounded.length;n++){
      if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
      count+=earthlineProcessMappedFeature(roadMask,buildingMask,bounded[n]);
      if((n&15)===15){earthlineProgress("hydrology","mapping roads and structures…");await earthlineYield();}
    }
    const seamM=2.5;
    roadMask=earthlineDilateMask(roadMask,Math.max(1,seamM/Math.max(0.2,M.cellM||1)));
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++)mask[i]=(roadMask[i]||buildingMask[i])?1:0;
  }catch(err){console.warn("[Earthline] mapped road/building mask unavailable",err);}
  M.vectorNoBuildMask=mask;M.vectorNoBuildCount=count;
  M.vectorNoBuildStamp=[M.centerLat.toFixed(6),M.centerLng.toFixed(6),M.viewZoom,count].join("|");
  M._noBuildStamp="";
  if(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage){
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.processedFeatureCount=count;
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.renderedFeatureCount=Number(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.featureCount||0);
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.featureCount=count;
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified=!!(
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.styleReady&&
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.layerCount>0&&
      count>0
    );
    if(!M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified){
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.unverifiedReason=count>0?null:
        (M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.layerCount>0?"no-road-or-building-features-in-analysis-frame":"no-relevant-style-layers");
    }
  }
  console.log("[Earthline] mapped exclusion features:",count,M.vectorNoBuildCoverage);
  return !!(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage&&M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified);
}

/* ================= BUILD-CHECK-15672 DEM + SWALE LAYER =================
   Use Mapbox GL's loaded Terrain-DEM instead of manually decoding raster
   tiles whenever possible. Swales are also mirrored into a geographic
   GeoJSON layer so they remain visible and aligned while the map moves. */
const EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE="earthline-dem";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_SOURCE="earthline-swales";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING="earthline-swales-casing";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_LAYER="earthline-swales-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE="earthline-aquifers";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_OUTER="earthline-aquifers-outer";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL="earthline-aquifers-fill";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LINE="earthline-aquifers-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-aquifers-highlight";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH="earthline-aquifers-dash";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL="earthline-aquifers-label";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398="earthline-aquifer-wells-16398";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398="earthline-aquifer-evidence-label-16398";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE="earthline-recharge-zones";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_CASING="earthline-recharge-casing";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_FILL="earthline-recharge-fill";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LINE="earthline-recharge-line";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-recharge-highlight";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LABEL="earthline-recharge-label";

function earthlineWaitForMapEvent(name,timeoutMs=8000){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    if(!earthlineMap){resolve(false);return;}
    let done=false;
    const finish=v=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(to);resolve(v);};
    const to=setTimeout(()=>finish(false),timeoutMs);
    earthlineMap.once(name,()=>finish(true));
  });
}

async function earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  if(!earthlineMapActive()||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  try{
    if(!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("style.load",8000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen)||!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())return false;
    if(!earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE)){
      earthlineMap.addSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,{
        type:"raster-dem",url:"mapbox://mapbox.terrain-rgb",tileSize:512,maxzoom:14
      });
    }
    const terrain=earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain();
    if(!terrain||terrain.source!==EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE){
      earthlineMap.setTerrain({source:EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,exaggeration:1});
    }
    earthlineMap.jumpTo({center:[M.centerLng,M.centerLat],zoom:Math.max(16.5,Math.min(18,M.viewZoom||17)),bearing:0,pitch:0});
    earthlineMap.triggerRepaint();
    await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("idle",10000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
    const z=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:M.centerLng,lat:M.centerLat},{exaggerated:false});
    return Number.isFinite(z);
  }catch(err){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM source unavailable",err);
    return false;
  }
}

async function earthlineSampleMapboxDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  const ready=await earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen);
  if(!ready||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  const analysisZ=Math.min(Math.max(16.5,earthlineMap.getZoom()||17),17);
  M.viewZoom=analysisZ;
  M.cellM=5*mppAt(analysisZ,M.centerLat);
  const raw=new Float32Array(N);
  raw.fill(NaN);
  let valid=0,sum=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const ll=earthlineGridToLngLat(x,y);
      const e=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:ll[0],lat:ll[1]},{exaggerated:false});
      if(Number.isFinite(e)){raw[idx(x,y)]=e;sum+=e;valid++;}
    }
    if((y&7)===7){await earthlineYield();if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;}
  }
  if(valid<N*0.65){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM coverage insufficient",{valid,total:N});
    return false;
  }
  const meanValid=sum/Math.max(1,valid);
  // Fill any edge cells without loaded elevation from nearby valid values.
  for(let pass=0;pass<4;pass++){
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y);if(Number.isFinite(raw[i]))continue;
      let sm=0,nn=0;
      for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
        const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
        const v=raw[idx(nx,ny)];if(Number.isFinite(v)){sm+=v;nn++;}
      }
      if(nn)raw[i]=sm/nn;
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)if(!Number.isFinite(raw[i]))raw[i]=meanValid;
  // Light 3x3 smoothing removes tile-scale noise while preserving real contours.
  let mean=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let sm=0,nn=0;
    for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
      const nx=clamp(x+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(y+oy,0,GH-1);sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];nn++;
    }
    const v=sm/nn;M.h[idx(x,y)]=v;mean+=v;
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  M.satCanvas=null;
  M.demSource="Mapbox GL Terrain-DEM";
  M.realMode=true;
  // Terrain mesh is only needed while sampling elevations. Keep the map flat afterward
  // so wheel zoom and pan stay smooth on ordinary laptops and phones.
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain())earthlineMap.setTerrain(null);}catch(e){}
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.setFog)earthlineMap.setFog(null);}catch(e){}
  return true;
}

  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let sm=0,nn=0;
    for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
      const nx=clamp(x+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(y+oy,0,GH-1);sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];nn++;
    }
    const v=sm/nn;M.h[idx(x,y)]=v;mean+=v;
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  M.satCanvas=null;
  M.demSource="Mapbox GL Terrain-DEM";
  M.realMode=true;
  // Terrain mesh is only needed while sampling elevations. Keep the map flat afterward
  // so wheel zoom and pan stay smooth on ordinary laptops and phones.
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain())earthlineMap.setTerrain(null);}catch(e){}
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.setFog)earthlineMap.setFog(null);}catch(e){}
  return true;
}

/* BUILD-CHECK-15673 VISUAL BASELINE PRESERVED IN BUILD-CHECK-15680.
   Recharge is translucent and behind the analytical canvas; flow is brighter; swales are thinner.
   No data-loading, analysis, placement, exclusion, artwork, or educational-copy logic changed. */
/* BUILD-CHECK-15672: unmistakable authoritative recharge overlay.
   One dedicated SVG is the only visible property-scale recharge renderer when Mapbox is active.
   It is independent 
));
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++)mask[i]=(roadMask[i]||buildingMask[i])?1:0;
  }catch(err){console.warn("[Earthline] mapped road/building mask unavailable",err);}
  M.vectorNoBuildMask=mask;M.vectorNoBuildCount=count;
  M.vectorNoBuildStamp=[M.centerLat.toFixed(6),M.centerLng.toFixed(6),M.viewZoom,count].join("|");
  M._noBuildStamp="";
  if(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage){
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.processedFeatureCount=count;
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.renderedFeatureCount=Number(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.featureCount||0);
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.featureCount=count;
    M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified=!!(
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.styleReady&&
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.layerCount>0&&
      count>0
    );
    if(!M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified){
      M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.unverifiedReason=count>0?null:
        (M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.layerCount>0?"no-road-or-building-features-in-analysis-frame":"no-relevant-style-layers");
    }
  }
  console.log("[Earthline] mapped exclusion features:",count,M.vectorNoBuildCoverage);
  return !!(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage&&M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified);
}

/* ================= BUILD-CHECK-15672 DEM + SWALE LAYER =================
   Use Mapbox GL's loaded Terrain-DEM instead of manually decoding raster
   tiles whenever possible. Swales are also mirrored into a geographic
   GeoJSON layer so they remain visible and aligned while the map moves. */
const EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE="earthline-dem";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_SOURCE="earthline-swales";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING="earthline-swales-casing";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_LAYER="earthline-swales-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE="earthline-aquifers";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_OUTER="earthline-aquifers-outer";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL="earthline-aquifers-fill";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LINE="earthline-aquifers-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-aquifers-highlight";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH="earthline-aquifers-dash";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL="earthline-aquifers-label";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398="earthline-aquifer-wells-16398";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398="earthline-aquifer-evidence-label-16398";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE="earthline-recharge-zones";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_CASING="earthline-recharge-casing";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_FILL="earthline-recharge-fill";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LINE="earthline-recharge-line";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-recharge-highlight";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LABEL="earthline-recharge-label";

function earthlineWaitForMapEvent(name,timeoutMs=8000){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    if(!earthlineMap){resolve(false);return;}
    let done=false;
    const finish=v=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(to);resolve(v);};
    const to=setTimeout(()=>finish(false),timeoutMs);
    earthlineMap.once(name,()=>finish(true));
  });
}

async function earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  if(!earthlineMapActive()||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  try{
    if(!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("style.load",8000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen)||!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())return false;
    if(!earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE)){
      earthlineMap.addSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,{
        type:"raster-dem",url:"mapbox://mapbox.terrain-rgb",tileSize:512,maxzoom:14
      });
    }
    const terrain=earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain();
    if(!terrain||terrain.source!==EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE){
      earthlineMap.setTerrain({source:EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,exaggeration:1});
    }
    earthlineMap.jumpTo({center:[M.centerLng,M.centerLat],zoom:Math.max(16.5,Math.min(18,M.viewZoom||17)),bearing:0,pitch:0});
    earthlineMap.triggerRepaint();
    await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("idle",10000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
    const z=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:M.centerLng,lat:M.centerLat},{exaggerated:false});
    return Number.isFinite(z);
  }catch(err){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM source unavailable",err);
    return false;
  }
}

async function earthlineSampleMapboxDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  const ready=await earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen);
  if(!ready||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  const analysisZ=Math.min(Math.max(16.5,earthlineMap.getZoom()||17),17);
  M.viewZoom=analysisZ;
  M.cellM=5*mppAt(analysisZ,M.centerLat);
  const raw=new Float32Array(N);
  raw.fill(NaN);
  let valid=0,sum=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const ll=earthlineGridToLngLat(x,y);
      const e=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:ll[0],lat:ll[1]},{exaggerated:false});
      if(Number.isFinite(e)){raw[idx(x,y)]=e;sum+=e;valid++;}
    }
    if((y&7)===7){await earthlineYield();if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;}
  }
  if(valid<N*0.65){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM coverage insufficient",{valid,total:N});
    return false;
  }
  const meanValid=sum/Math.max(1,valid);
  // Fill any edge cells without loaded elevation from nearby valid values.
  for(let pass=0;pass<4;pass++){
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y);if(Number.isFinite(raw[i]))continue;
      let sm=0,nn=0;
      for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
        const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
        const v=raw[idx(nx,ny)];if(Number.isFinite(v)){sm+=v;nn++;}
      }
      if(nn)raw[i]=sm/nn;
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)if(!Number.isFinite(raw[i]))raw[i]=meanValid;
  // Light 3x3 smoothing removes tile-scale noise while preserving real contours.
  let mean=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let sm=0,nn=0;
    for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
      const nx=clamp(x+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(y+oy,0,GH-1);sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];nn++;
    }
    const v=sm/nn;M.h[idx(x,y)]=v;mean+=v;
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  M.satCanvas=null;
  M.demSource="Mapbox GL Terrain-DEM";
  M.realMode=true;
  // Terrain mesh is only needed while sampling elevations. Keep the map flat afterward
  // so wheel zoom and pan stay smooth on ordinary laptops and phones.
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain())earthlineMap.setTerrain(null);}catch(e){}
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.setFog)earthlineMap.setFog(null);}catch(e){}
  return true;
}

function earthlineRechargeGridRing(z){
  const key=[z.gx||0,z.gy||0,z.rx||18,z.ry||10,z.a||0].join("|");
  if(z._earthlineGridRingKey===key&&Array.isArray(z._earthlineGridRing))return z._earthlineGridRing;
  const pts=[];
  const ca=Math.cos(z.a||0),sa=Math.sin(z.a||0),steps=64;
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const t=i/steps*Math.PI*2;
    const ex=(z.rx||18)*Math.cos(t),ey=(z.ry||10)*Math.sin(t);
    pts.push([(z.gx||0)+ex*ca-ey*sa,(z.gy||0)+ex*sa+ey*ca]);
  }
  z._earthlineGridRingKey=key;
  z._earthlineGridRing=pts;
  return pts;
}
function earthlineRechargeProjectedRing(z){
  // The parcel model uses one local, north-up affine transform. Reuse the cached grid
  // ellipse and apply view scale/origin directly instead of calling Mapbox.project()
  // dozens of times per zone after every click, zoom, or pan.
  const s=view.s,ox=view.ox,oy=view.oy;
  return earthlineRechargeGridRing(z).map(p=>[ox+p[0]*s,oy+p[1]*s]);
}

  if(oldSvg){oldSvg.style.display="none";oldSvg.style.visibility="hidden";oldSvg.replaceC
dCoverage&&M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified);
}

      const nx=clamp(x+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(y+oy,0,GH-1);sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];nn++;
    }
    const v=sm/nn;M.h[idx(x,y)]=v;mean+=v;
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  M.satCanvas=null;
  M.demSource="Mapbox GL Terrain-DEM";
  M.realMode=true;
  // Terrain mesh is only needed while sampling elevations. Keep the map flat afterward
  // so wheel zoom and pan stay smooth on ordinary laptops and phones.
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain())earthlineMap.setTerrain(null);}catch(e){}
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.setFog)earthlineMap.setFog(null);}catch(e){}
  return true;
}

   No data-loading, analysis, placement, exclusion, artwork, or educational-copy logic changed. */
/* BUILD-CHECK-15672: unmistakable authoritative recharge overlay.
   One dedicated SVG is the only visible property-scale recharge renderer when Mapbox is active.
   It is independent of Mapbox custom-layer creation and independent of the legacy canvas path.
   The SVG sits above satellite imagery and below the analytical canvas/swales. */
function earthlineRechargeSvgVisible(){
  const L=M.layers&&M.layers.recharge;
  return !!(earthlineMapActive()&&L&&L.on&&M.rechZones&&M.rechZones.length&&
    !earthlineLargeAreaMode()&&!earthlinePlanningMode());
}
function earthlineRechargeGridRing(z){
  const key=[z.gx||0,z.gy||0,z.rx||18,z.ry||10,z.a||0].join("|");
  if(z._earthlineGridRingKey===key&&Array.isArray(z._earthlineGridRing))return z._earthlineGridRing;
  const pts=[];
  const ca=Math.cos(z.a||0),sa=Math.sin(z.a||0),steps=64;
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const t=i/steps*Math.PI*2;
    const ex=(z.rx||18)*Math.cos(t),ey=(z.ry||10)*Math.sin(t);
    pts.push([(z.gx||0)+ex*ca-ey*sa,(z.gy||0)+ex*sa+ey*ca]);
  }
  z._earthlineGridRingKey=key;
  z._earthlineGridRing=pts;
  return pts;
}
function earthlineRechargeProjectedRing(z){
  // The parcel model uses one local, north-up affine transform. Reuse the cached grid
  // ellipse and apply view scale/origin directly instead of calling Mapbox.project()
  // dozens of times per zone after every click, zoom, or pan.
  const s=view.s,ox=view.ox,oy=view.oy;
  return earthlineRechargeGridRing(z).map(p=>[ox+p[0]*s,oy+p[1]*s]);
}
function earthlineUpdateRechargeSvg(force){
  const canvas=document.getElementById("earthlineRechargeCanvas");
  const oldSvg=document.getElementById("earthlineRechargeOverlay");
  if(oldSvg){oldSvg.style.display="none";oldSvg.style.visibility="hidden";oldSvg.replaceChildren();}
  if(!canvas)return false;

  /* EARTHLIN
wales are also mirrored into a geographic
   GeoJSON layer so they remain visible and aligned while the map moves. */
const EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE="earthline-dem";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_SOURCE="earthline-swales";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING="earthline-swales-casing";
const EARTHLINE_SWALE_LAYER="earthline-swales-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE="earthline-aquifers";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_OUTER="earthline-aquifers-outer";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL="earthline-aquifers-fill";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LINE="earthline-aquifers-line";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-aquifers-highlight";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH="earthline-aquifers-dash";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL="earthline-aquifers-label";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398="earthline-aquifer-wells-16398";
const EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398="earthline-aquifer-evidence-label-16398";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE="earthline-recharge-zones";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_CASING="earthline-recharge-casing";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_FILL="earthline-recharge-fill";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LINE="earthline-recharge-line";
const EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_HIGHLIGHT="earthline-recharge-highlight";

function earthlineWaitForMapEvent(name,timeoutMs=8000){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    if(!earthlineMap){resolve(false);return;}
    let done=false;
    const finish=v=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(to);resolve(v);};
    const to=setTimeout(()=>finish(false),timeoutMs);
    earthlineMap.once(name,()=>finish(true));
  });
}

async function earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  if(!earthlineMapActive()||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  try{
    if(!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("style.load",8000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen)||!earthlineMap.isStyleLoaded())return false;
    if(!earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE)){
      earthlineMap.addSource(EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,{
        type:"raster-dem",url:"mapbox://mapbox.terrain-rgb",tileSize:512,maxzoom:14
      });
    }
    const terrain=earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain();
    if(!terrain||terrain.source!==EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE){
      earthlineMap.setTerrain({source:EARTHLINE_DEM_SOURCE,exaggeration:1});
    }
    earthlineMap.jumpTo({center:[M.centerLng,M.centerLat],zoom:Math.max(16.5,Math.min(18,M.viewZoom||17)),bearing:0,pitch:0});
    earthlineMap.triggerRepaint();
    await earthlineWaitForMapEvent("idle",10000);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
    const z=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:M.centerLng,lat:M.centerLat},{exaggerated:false});
    return Number.isFinite(z);
  }catch(err){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM source unavailable",err);
    return false;
  }
}

async function earthlineSampleMapboxDem(myGen=M.searchGen){
  const ready=await earthlineEnsureMapDem(myGen);
  if(!ready||earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  const analysisZ=Math.min(Math.max(16.5,earthlineMap.getZoom()||17),17);
  M.viewZoom=analysisZ;
  M.cellM=5*mppAt(analysisZ,M.centerLat);
  const raw=new Float32Array(N);
  raw.fill(NaN);
  let valid=0,sum=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const ll=earthlineGridToLngLat(x,y);
      const e=earthlineMap.queryTerrainElevation({lng:ll[0],lat:ll[1]},{exaggerated:false});
      if(Number.isFinite(e)){raw[idx(x,y)]=e;sum+=e;valid++;}
    }
    if((y&7)===7){await earthlineYield();if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;}
  }
  if(valid<N*0.65){
    console.warn("[Earthline] Mapbox GL DEM coverage insufficient",{valid,total:N});
    return false;
  }
  const meanValid=sum/Math.max(1,valid);
  // Fill any edge cells without loaded elevation from nearby valid values.
  for(let pass=0;pass<4;pass++){
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y);if(Number.isFinite(raw[i]))continue;
      let sm=0,nn=0;
      for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
        const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
        const v=raw[idx(nx,ny)];if(Number.isFinite(v)){sm+=v;nn++;}
      }
      if(nn)raw[i]=sm/nn;
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)if(!Number.isFinite(raw[i]))raw[i]=meanValid;
  // Light 3x3 smoothing removes tile-scale noise while preserving real contours.
  let mean=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let sm=0,nn=0;
    for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
      const nx=clamp(x+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(y+oy,0,GH-1);sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];nn++;
    }
    const v=sm/nn;M.h[idx(x,y)]=v;mean+=v;
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  M.satCanvas=null;
  M.demSource="Mapbox GL Terrain-DEM";
  M.realMode=true;
  // Terrain mesh is only needed while sampling elevations. Keep the map flat afterward
  // so wheel zoom and pan stay smooth on ordinary laptops and phones.
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.getTerrain&&earthlineMap.getTerrain())earthlineMap.setTerrain(null);}catch(e){}
  try{if(earthlineMap&&earthlineMap.setFog)earthlineMap.setFog(null);}catch(e){}
  return true;
}

function earthlineRechargeGeoJSON(){
  const features=[];
  let omittedPropertyTargets16326=0;
  let adjustedPropertyTargets16326=0;
  let rechargeLabelAssigned16451=false;
  for(const rawZone16326 of (M.rechZones||[])){
    const z=earthlineContainedRechargeZone16326(rawZone16326);
    if(!z){omittedPropertyTargets16326++;continue;}
    if(Number(z.propertyContainmentScale16326||1)<.999)adjustedPropertyTargets16326++;
    const ring=[];
    const steps=64;
    const ca=Math.cos(z.a||0),sa=Math.sin(z.a||0);
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const t=i/steps*Math.PI*2;
      const ex=(z.rx||18)*Math.cos(t),ey=(z.ry||10)*Math.sin(t);
      const gx=(z.gx||0)+ex*ca-ey*sa;
      const gy=(z.gy||0)+ex*sa+ey*ca;
      ring.push(earthlineGridToLngLat(gx,gy));
    }
    features.push({
      type:"Feature",
      properties:{id:z.id||"R",label:rechargeLabelAssigned16451?"":"MODELED RECHARGE TARGETS",score:Number(z.s||0)},
      geometry:{type:"Polygon",coordinates:[ring]}
    });
    rechargeLabelAssigned16451=true;
  }
  if(earthlinePropertyTierActive16326()){
    window.EARTHLINE_PROPERTY_RECHARGE_CONTAINMENT_AUDIT_16326={
      build:"EARTHLINE 16326",
      sourceTargets:Number((M.rechZones||[]).length),
      displayedTargets:Number(features.length),
      adjustedTargets:Number(adjustedPropertyTargets16326),
      omittedTargets:Number(omittedPropertyTargets16326),
      rule:"declared-property + final-no-build + pond containment",
      scientificTargetsUnchanged:true,
      at:new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
  return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
}
function earthlineEnsureRechargeLayers(){
  if(!earthlineMapActive()){
    window.EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LAYER_ENSURE_AUDIT_16500={ok:false,reason:"map-inactive",at:new Date().toISOString()};
    return false;
  }
  try{
    const liveStyle=(earthlineMap.getStyle&&earthlineMap.getStyle())||null;
    if(!liveStyle){
      window.EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LAYER_ENSURE_AUDIT_16500={ok:false,reason:"style-unavailable",at:new Date().toISOString()};
      return false;
    }
    if(!earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE)){
      earthlineMap.addSource(EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE,{type:"geojson",data:{type:"FeatureCollection",features:[]}});
    }
    const before=earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING)?EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING:undefined;
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_CASING)){
      earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_CASING,type:"line",source:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE,
        layout:{"line-cap":"round","line-join":"round"},
        paint:{"line-color":"#241006","line-width":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],12,5,16,7,19,8],"line-opacity":0.62}},before);
    }
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_FILL)){
      earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_FILL,type:"fill",source:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE,
        paint:{"fill-color":"#f06400","fill-opacity":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],10,0.34,14,0.32,17,0.24,20,0.18]}},before);
    }
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LINE)){
      earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_LINE,type:"line",source:EARTHLINE_RECHARGE_SOURCE,
        layout:{"line-cap":"round","line-join":"round"},
        paint:{"line-color":"#ff920f","line-width":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],10,2.2,16,3.5,20,4.2],"line-opacity":0.82}},before);
    }

function earthlineRechargeGeoJSON(){
  const features=[];
  let omittedPropertyTargets16326=0;
  let adjustedPropertyTargets16326=0;
  let rechargeLabelAssigned16451=false;
  for(const rawZone16326 of (M.rechZones||[])){
    const z=earthlineContainedRechargeZone16326(rawZone16326);
    if(!z){omittedPropertyTargets16326++;continue;}
    if(Number(z.propertyContainmentScale16326||1)<.999)adjustedPropertyTargets16326++;
    const ring=[];
    const steps=64;
    const ca=Math.cos(z.a||0),sa=Math.sin(z.a||0);
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const t=i/steps*Math.PI*2;
      const ex=(z.rx||18)*Math.cos(t),ey=(z.ry||10)*Math.sin(t);
      const gx=(z.gx||0)+ex*ca-ey*sa;
      const gy=(z.gy||0)+ex*sa+ey*ca;
      ring.push(earthlineGridToLngLat(gx,gy));
    }
    features.push({
      type:"Feature",
      properties:{id:z.id||"R",label:rechargeLabelAssigned16451?"":"MODELED RECHARGE TARGETS",score:Number(z.s||0)},
      geometry:{type:"Polygon",coordinates:[ring]}
    });
    rechargeLabelAssigned16451=true;
  }
  if(earthlinePropertyTierActive16326()){
    window.EARTHLINE_PROPERTY_RECHARGE_CONTAINMENT_AUDIT_16326={
      build:"EARTHLINE 16326",
      sourceTargets:Number((M.rechZones||[]).length),
      displayedTargets:Number(features.length),
      adjustedTargets:Number(adjustedPropertyTargets16326),
      omittedTargets:Number(omittedPropertyTargets16326),
      rule:"declared-property + final-no-build + pond containment",
      scientificTargetsUnchanged:true,
      at:new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
  return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}

}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}
function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);
    x=clamp(x-g[0]*step,0,GW-1);
    y=clamp(y-g[1]*step,0,GH-1);
  }
  return [x,y];
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}
function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);
    x=clamp(x-g[0]*step,0,GW-1);
    y=clamp(y-g[1]*step,0,GH-1);
  }
  return [x,y];
}

// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;

function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);

function earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<4)return pts||[];
  const targetH=earthlineMedian(pts.map(p=>hAt(p[0],p[1])));
  let current=pts.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]);
  const passes=current.length>18?2:1;
  for(let pass=0;pass<passes;pass++){
    const next=[current[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<current.length-1;i++){
      const a=current[i],b=current[i+1];
      next.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
      next.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
    }
    next.push(current[current.length-1]);
    current=next;
  }
  const corrected=current.map((p,i)=>{
    if(i===0||i===current.length-1)return p;
    const q=earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH);
    const gx=Math.round(q[0]),gy=Math.round(q[1]);
    // Never smooth a displayed line through a road, structure, stream, or steep/no-build cell.
    return earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,33)?q:p;
  });
  return earthlineCleanPath(corrected);
}

  let current=pts.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]);
  const passes=current.length>18?2:1;
  for(let pass=0;pass<passes;pass++){
    const next=[current[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<current.length-1;i++){
      const a=current[i],b=current[i+1];
      next.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
      next.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
    }
    next.push(current[current.length-1]);
    current=next;
  }
  const corrected=current.map((p,i)=>{
    if(i===0||i===current.length-1)return p;
    const q=earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH);
    const gx=Math.round(q[0]),gy=Math.round(q[1]);
    // Never smooth a displayed line through a road, structure, stream, or steep/no-build cell.
    return earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,33)?q:p;
  });
  return earthlineCleanPath(corrected);
}
function earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(pts,maxS=33){
  const out=[];let cur=[];let prev=null;
  const flush=()=>{
    if(cur.length>=2&&earthlinePathLengthM(cur)>=10)out.push(earthlineCleanPath(cur));
    cur=[];
  };
  for(const p of (pts||[])){
    let ok=earthlinePathPointUsable(p[0],p[1],maxS);
    if(ok&&prev){
      const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])*2));
      for(let k=1;k<steps;k++){
        const t=k/steps;

          prev[0]+(p[0]-prev[0])*t,
          prev[1]+(p[1]-prev[1])*t,
          maxS
        )){ok=false;break;}
      }
    }
    if(ok)cur.push(p);else flush();
    prev=p;
  }
  flush();
  return out;
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}
function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);
    x=clamp(x-g[0]*step,0,GW-1);
    y=clamp(y-g[1]*step,0,GH-1);
  }
  return [x,y];
}
function earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<4)return pts||[];
  const targetH=earthlineMedian(pts.map(p=>hAt(p[0],p[1])));
  let current=pts.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]);
  const passes=current.length>18?2:1;
  for(let pass=0;pass<passes;pass++){
    const next=[current[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<current.length-1;i++){
      const a=current[i],b=current[i+1];
      next.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
      next.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
    }
    next.push(current[current.length-1]);
    current=next;
  }
  const corrected=current.map((p,i)=>{
    if(i===0||i===current.length-1)return p;
    const q=earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH);
    const gx=Math.round(q[0]),gy=Math.round(q[1]);
    // Never smooth a displayed line through a road, structure, stream, or steep/no-build cell.
    return earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,33)?q:p;
  });
  return earthlineCleanPath(corrected);
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}
function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);
    x=clamp(x-g[0]*step,0,GW-1);
    y=clamp(y-g[1]*step,0,GH-1);
  }
  return [x,y];
}
function earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<4)return pts||[];
  const targetH=earthlineMedian(pts.map(p=>hAt(p[0],p[1])));
  let current=pts.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]);
  const passes=current.length>18?2:1;
  for(let pass=0;pass<passes;pass++){
    const next=[current[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<current.length-1;i++){
      const a=current[i],b=current[i+1];
      next.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
      next.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
    }
    next.push(current[current.length-1]);
    current=next;
  }
  const corrected=current.map((p,i)=>{
    if(i===0||i===current.length-1)return p;
    const q=earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH);
    const gx=Math.round(q[0]),gy=Math.round(q[1]);
    // Never smooth a displayed line through a road, structure, stream, or steep/no-build cell.
    return earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,33)?q:p;
  });
  return earthlineCleanPath(corrected);
}
function earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(pts,maxS=33){
  const out=[];let cur=[];let prev=null;
  const flush=()=>{
    if(cur.length>=2&&earthlinePathLengthM(cur)>=10)out.push(earthlineCleanPath(cur));
    cur=[];
  };
  for(const p of (pts||[])){
    let ok=earthlinePathPointUsable(p[0],p[1],maxS);
    if(ok&&prev){
      const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])*2));
      for(let k=1;k<steps;k++){
        const t=k/steps;
        if(!earthlinePathPointUsable(
          prev[0]+(p[0]-prev[0])*t,
          prev[1]+(p[1]-prev[1])*t,
          maxS
        )){ok=false;break;}
      }
    }
    if(ok)cur.push(p);else flush();
    prev=p;
  }
  flush();
  return out;
}
function earthlinePathLengthM(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<2)return 0;
  let d=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]);
  return d*M.cellM;
}

      // but the map shows only field-legible corridors unless it is the central site candidate.
      if(rawLen<minVisibleM&&!s.isSite)continue;
      const displaySeg=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(seg);
      for(const safeDisplay of earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(displaySeg,33)){
        if(!safeDisplay||safeDisplay.length<2)continue;
        features.push({type:"Feature",properties:{id:s.id||"",score:Number(s.score||0),scale:"property"},
          geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:safeDisplay.map(p=>earthlineGridToLngLat(p[0],p[1]))}});
      }
    }
  }
  return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
}

function earthlineSyncSwaleLayer(){
  if(!earthlineMapActive())return false;
  if(!earthlineEnsureSwaleLayers())return false;
  const data=earthlineSwaleGeoJSON();
  const src=earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_SWALE_SOURCE);
  if(src&&src.setData)src.setData(data);
  const show=!!(M.layers&&M.layers.swales&&M.layers.swales.on&&data.features.length);
  for(const id of [EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING,EARTHLINE_SWALE_LAYER]){
    if(earthlineMap.getLayer(id))earthlineMap.setLayoutProperty(id,"visibility",show?"visible":"none");
  }
  return show;
}

/* ---------------- RNG + noise ---------------- */
function hashStr(s){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}return h>>>0;}
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
function latHash(ix,iy,seed){let n=ix*374761393+iy*668265263+seed*1442695041;n=(n^(n>>13))*1274126177;n=n^(n>>16);return(n>>>0)/4294967296;}
function smoothT(t){return t*t*(3-2*t);}
function vnoise(x,y,seed){
  const ix=Math.floor(x),iy=Math.floor(y),fx=x-ix,fy=y-iy;
  const a=latHash(ix,iy,seed),b=latHash(ix+1,iy,seed),c=latHash(ix,iy+1,seed),d=latHash(ix+1,iy+1,seed);
  const u=smoothT(fx),v=smoothT(fy);
  return a*(1-u)*(1-v)+b*u*(1-v)+c*(1-u)*v+d*u*v;
}
function fbm(x,y,seed,oct){let v=0,amp=0.5,f=1;for(let i=0;i<oct;i++){v+=amp*vnoise(x*f,y*f,seed+i*101);f*=2;amp*=0.5;}return v;}
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const fmt=n=>Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");

    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT,type:"line",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,layout:{"visibility":"none","line-cap":"round","line-join":"round"},paint:{"line-color":"#fff1c7","line-width":1.1}});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH,type:"line",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,layout:{"visibility":"none","line-cap":"butt","line-join":"round"},paint:{"line-color":"#fff","line-width":0.8,"line-dasharray":[1.1,1.1]}});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL,type:"symbol",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,minzoom:4.5,filter:["==",["geometry-type"],"Polygon"],layout:{
      "visibility":"none",
      "text-field":["concat","AQUIFER · ",["get","name"]],
      "text-size":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],4.5,13,11,16,15,16,19,17],
      "text-font":["Open Sans Bold","Arial Unicode MS Bold"],
      "text-allow-overlap":true,
      "text-ignore-placement":true,
      "text-padding":4
    },paint:{"text-color":"#fff7e6","text-opacity":1,"text-halo-color":"rgba(35,10,0,1)","text-halo-width":5,"text-halo-blur":0.2}});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398))earthlineMap.addLayer({
      id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398,type:"circle",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,
      filter:["==",["get","featureKind"],"well"],layout:{"visibility":"none"},paint:{
        "circle-radius":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],11,3.5,14,5.5,17,7],

      }});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398))earthlineMap.addLayer({
      id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398,type:"symbol",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,minzoom:12.5,
      filter:["==",["get","featureKind"],"groundwater-summary"],layout:{
        "visibility":"none","text-field":["get","name"],
        "text-size":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],12.5,11.5,16,13.5,19,15],
        "text-font":["Open Sans Bold","Arial Unicode MS Bold"],"text-max-width":24,"text-line-height":1.08,"text-allow-overlap":true,"text-ignore-placement":true
      },paint:{"text-color":"#ffd08a","text-halo-color":"rgba(18,6,0,.99)","text-halo-width":5.0,"text-halo-blur":.08}});
    earthlineApplyAquiferLayerStyle();

function earthlineSyncAquiferLayer(){
  if(!earthlineMapActive())return false;
  if(!earthlineEnsureAquiferLayers())return false;
  try{
    const src=earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE);
    const data=earthlineAquiferGeoJSON();
    if(src&&src.setData)src.setData(data);
    earthlineApplyAquiferLayerStyle();

    const requested=!!(
      M.layers&&M.layers.usgsAquifer&&M.layers.usgsAquifer.on&&
      ((M.usgsAquifers&&M.usgsAquifers.length)||(M.vtGroundwaterWells16398&&M.vtGroundwaterWells16398.length)||M.vtGroundwaterSummaryPoint16398)
    );
    if(M.usgsAquiferAudit){
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.mapboxSourceFeatures=data.features.length;
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.requestedVisible=requested;
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.visibilityOwner="earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805";
    }
    if(typeof window.earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805==="function"){
      window.earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805(
        (window.earthlineRegional15778||{}).mode==="regional"
          ?"regional":"property"
      );
    }
    return requested;
  }catch(e){
    console.warn("[Earthline] aquifer sync failed",e);
    return false;
  }
}
function earthlineNativeAquiferActive(){
  const hasEvidence=!!((M.usgsAquifers&&M.usgsAquifers.length)||(M.vtGroundwaterWells16398&&M.vtGroundwaterWells16398.length)||M.vtGroundwaterSummaryPoint16398);
  return !!(earthlineMapActive()&&earthlineMap.getLayer&&earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL)&&M.layers&&M.layers.usgsAquifer&&M.layers.usgsAquifer.on&&hasEvidence);
}

function earthlineParseAquiferFeatures(j,format,options={}){
  const polys=[];
  const features=j.features||[];
  features.forEach(f=>{
    const p=f.properties||f.attributes||{};
    const rawName=p.AQ_NAME||p.ROCK_NAME||p.AQUIFER_NAME||p.NAME||p.AQUIFER||"";
    const name=rawName||options.defaultName||"Principal aquifer";
    const source=options.source||"USGS principal aquifers";
    const aquiferType=options.aquiferType||"principal";
    const perm=aquiferPermFromName(name+" "+(p.ROCK_NAME||""));
    if(format==="geojson"){
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g)return;
      const rings=g.type==="Polygon"?[g.coordinates]:g.type==="MultiPolygon"?g.coordinates:[];
      rings.forEach(poly=>poly.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatPts=ring.map(c=>[Number(c[0]),Number(c[1])]);
        polys.push({name,source,aquiferType,perm,lngLatPts,pts:lngLatPts.map(c=>lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]))});
      }));
    }else{
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g||!g.rings)return;
      g.rings.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatP
ext-color","#fff7e6");
      earthlineMap.setPaintProperty(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL,"text-halo-color","rgba(35,10,0,1)");
      earthlineMap.setPaintProperty(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL,"text-halo-width",5);
      earthlineMap.setPaintProperty(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL,"text-halo-blur",0.2);
    }

    // Keep official aquifers above satellite/road labels and below swale recommendations.
    // The canvas enhancer is still drawn above all Mapbox layers for guaranteed visibility.
    const before=earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING)?EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING:undefined;
    [EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL,EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_OUTER,EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LINE,
      EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_HIGHLIGHT,EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH,EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398,
      EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398,EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL].forEach(id=>{
      if(earthlineMap.getLayer(id))earthlineMap.moveLayer(id,before);
    });
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn("[Earthline] aquifer restyle/order failed",e);return false;}
}
function earthlineEnsureAquiferLayers(){

    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL,type:"fill",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,layout:{"visibility":"none"},paint:{"fill-color":"#ff7600","fill-opacity":0.04}});

    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_DASH,type:"line",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,layout:{"visibility":"none","line-cap":"butt","line-join":"round"},paint:{"line-color":"#fff","line-width":0.8,"line-dasharray":[1.1,1.1]}});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL))earthlineMap.addLayer({id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_LABEL,type:"symbol",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,minzoom:4.5,filter:["==",["geometry-type"],"Polygon"],layout:{
      "visibility":"none",
      "text-field":["concat","AQUIFER · ",["get","name"]],
      "text-size":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],4.5,13,11,16,15,16,19,17],
      "text-font":["Open Sans Bold","Arial Unicode MS Bold"],
      "text-allow-overlap":true,
      "text-ignore-placement":true,
      "text-padding":4
    },paint:{"text-color":"#fff7e6","text-opacity":1,"text-halo-color":"rgba(35,10,0,1)","text-halo-width":5,"text-halo-blur":0.2}});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398))earthlineMap.addLayer({
      id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_WELLS_16398,type:"circle",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,
      filter:["==",["get","featureKind"],"well"],layout:{"visibility":"none"},paint:{
        "circle-radius":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],11,3.5,14,5.5,17,7],
        "circle-color":"#ffd07a","circle-opacity":0.96,"circle-stroke-color":"#3b1800","circle-stroke-width":2
      }});
    if(!earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398))earthlineMap.addLayer({
      id:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_EVIDENCE_LABEL_16398,type:"symbol",source:EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE,minzoom:12.5,
      filter:["==",["get","featureKind"],"groundwater-summary"],layout:{
        "visibility":"none","text-field":["get","name"],
        "text-size":["interpolate",["linear"],["zoom"],12.5,11.5,16,13.5,19,15],
        "text-font":["Open Sans Bold","Arial Unicode MS Bold"],"text-max-width":24,"text-line-height":1.08,"text-allow-overlap":true,"text-ignore-placement":true
      },paint:{"text-color":"#ffd08a","text-halo-color":"rgba(18,6,0,.99)","text-halo-width":5.0,"text-halo-blur":.08}});
    earthlineApplyAquiferLayerStyle();
    return true;

}
function earthlineSyncAquiferLayer(){
  if(!earthlineMapActive())return false;
  if(!earthlineEnsureAquiferLayers())return false;
  try{
    const src=earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_SOURCE);
    const data=earthlineAquiferGeoJSON();
    if(src&&src.setData)src.setData(data);
    earthlineApplyAquiferLayerStyle();

    const requested=!!(
      M.layers&&M.layers.usgsAquifer&&M.layers.usgsAquifer.on&&
      ((M.usgsAquifers&&M.usgsAquifers.length)||(M.vtGroundwaterWells16398&&M.vtGroundwaterWells16398.length)||M.vtGroundwaterSummaryPoint16398)
    );
    if(M.usgsAquiferAudit){
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.mapboxSourceFeatures=data.features.length;
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.requestedVisible=requested;
      M.usgsAquiferAudit.visibilityOwner="earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805";
    }
    if(typeof window.earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805==="function"){
      window.earthlineApplyRendererOwnership15805(
        (window.earthlineRegional15778||{}).mode==="regional"
          ?"regional":"property"
      );
    }
    return requested;
  }catch(e){
    console.warn("[Earthline] aquifer sync failed",e);
    return false;
  }
}

function earthlineParseAquiferFeatures(j,format,options={}){
  const polys=[];
  const features=j.features||[];
  features.forEach(f=>{
    const p=f.properties||f.attributes||{};
    const rawName=p.AQ_NAME||p.ROCK_NAME||p.AQUIFER_NAME||p.NAME||p.AQUIFER||"";
    const name=rawName||options.defaultName||"Principal aquifer";
    const source=options.source||"USGS principal aquifers";
    const aquiferType=options.aquiferType||"principal";
    const perm=aquiferPermFromName(name+" "+(p.ROCK_NAME||""));
    if(format==="geojson"){
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g)return;
      const rings=g.type==="Polygon"?[g.coordinates]:g.type==="MultiPolygon"?g.coordinates:[];
      rings.forEach(poly=>poly.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatPts=ring.map(c=>[Number(c[0]),Number(c[1])]);
        polys.push({name,source,aquiferType,perm,lngLatPts,pts:lngLatPts.map(c=>lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]))});
      }));
    }else{
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g||!g.rings)return;
      g.rings.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatPts=ring.map(c=>[Number(c[0]),Number(c[1])]);
        polys.push({name,source,aquiferType,perm,lngLatPts,pts:lngLatPts.map(c=>lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]))});
      });
    }
  });
  return polys;
}

    );

      );
    }
    return requested;
  }catch(e){
    console.warn("[Earthline] aquifer sync failed",e);
    return false;
  }
}
function earthlineNativeAquiferActive(){
  const hasEvidence=!!((M.usgsAquifers&&M.usgsAquifers.length)||(M.vtGroundwaterWells16398&&M.vtGroundwaterWells16398.length)||M.vtGroundwaterSummaryPoint16398);
  return !!(earthlineMapActive()&&earthlineMap.getLayer&&earthlineMap.getLayer(EARTHLINE_AQUIFER_FILL)&&M.layers&&M.layers.usgsAquifer&&M.layers.usgsAquifer.on&&hasEvidence);
}

function earthlineParseAquiferFeatures(j,format,options={}){
  const polys=[];
  const features=j.features||[];
  features.forEach(f=>{
    const p=f.properties||f.attributes||{};
    const rawName=p.AQ_NAME||p.ROCK_NAME||p.AQUIFER_NAME||p.NAME||p.AQUIFER||"";
    const name=rawName||options.defaultName||"Principal aquifer";
    const source=options.source||"USGS principal aquifers";
    const aquiferType=options.aquiferType||"principal";
    const perm=aquiferPermFromName(name+" "+(p.ROCK_NAME||""));
    if(format==="geojson"){
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g)return;
      const rings=g.type==="Polygon"?[g.coordinates]:g.type==="MultiPolygon"?g.coordinates:[];
      rings.forEach(poly=>poly.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatPts=ring.map(c=>[Number(c[0]),Number(c[1])]);
        polys.push({name,source,aquiferType,perm,lngLatPts,pts:lngLatPts.map(c=>lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]))});
      }));
    }else{
      const g=f.geometry;if(!g||!g.rings)return;
      g.rings.forEach(ring=>{
        const lngLatPts=ring.map(c=>[Number(c[0]),Number(c[1])]);
        polys.push({name,source,aquiferType,perm,lngLatPts,pts:lngLatPts.map(c=>lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]))});
      });
    }
  });
  return polys;
}

function earthlinePropertyAquiferQueryBBox16391(site){
  const pts=Array.isArray(site&&site.analysisBoundaryLngLat)?site.analysisBoundaryLngLat:[];
  let minLng=Infinity,minLat=Infinity,maxLng=-Infinity,maxLat=-Infinity;
  for(const p of pts){
    const x=Number(p&&p[0]),y=Number(p&&p[1]);
    if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y))continue;
    minLng=Math.min(minLng,x);maxLng=Math.max(maxLng,x);minLat=Math.min(minLat,y);maxLat=Math.max(maxLat,y);
  }
  const cx=Number(site&&site.lng),cy=Number(site&&site.lat);
  if(!Number.isFinite(minLng)||!Number.isFinite(minLat)||!Number.isFinite(maxLng)||!Number.isFinite(maxLat)){
    if(!Number.isFinite(cx)||!Number.isFinite(cy))return null;
    minLng=maxLng=cx;minLat=maxLat=cy;
  }
  const midLat=Number.isFinite(cy)?cy:(minLat+maxLat)/2;
  const cos=Math.max(.35,Math.cos(midLat*Math.PI/180));
  const spanLng=Math.max(0,maxLng-minLng),spanLat=Math.max(0,maxLat-minLat);
  /* Property science is local, but mapped aquifer context is regional. Query a stable
     authoritative context window around the selected Property rather than the camera
     position that may still belong to the previous search. No geometry is invented. */
  const padLat=Math.max(.12,spanLat*4);
  const padLng=Math.max(.12/cos,spanLng*4);
  return {minLng:minLng-padLng,minLat:minLat-padLat,maxLng:maxLng+padLng,maxLat:maxLat+padLat};
}

}

/* BUILD-CHECK-15768 — isolated real swale engine correction
   Source: BUILD-CHECK-15761.

   Direct corrections from the 15761 browser evidence:
   - The dashed regional corridor was created, but the run stopped after a partial group of
     tiles and left all visible results in the southern block.
   - "Median Spacing" remained about 100 ft because the prior prescription enforced only
     the 15 ft minimum; it did not insert missing contours when gaps exceeded 25 ft.

     rule is the current map center/visible region at the moment Run Analysis is pressed.

   1) anchors every regional run to earthlineMap.getCenter() at button press;

   3) retries each tile once and continues after a failed/withheld tile instead of aborting;
   4) converts every tile's grid output with that tile's saved center and cell size;

  function earthlinePointSegmentDistance15803(px,py,ax,ay,bx,by){
    const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    if(l2<=1e-12)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
    const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2));
    return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy));
  }
  function earthlinePointSegmentClosest15843(px15843,py15843,ax15843,ay15843,bx15843,by15843){
    const dx15843=bx15843-ax15843,dy15843=by15843-ay15843,l215843=dx15843*dx15843+dy15843*dy15843;
    const t15843=l215843<=1e-12?0:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((px15843-ax15843)*dx15843+(py15843-ay15843)*dy15843)/l215843));
    const x15843=ax15843+t15843*dx15843,y15843=ay15843+t15843*dy15843;
    return {distanceCells:Math.hypot(px15843-x15843,py15843-y15843),t:t15843,x:x15843,y:y15843};
  }
  function earthlineClosestPointOnSwale15843(sw15843,gx15843,gy15843,corridorIndex15843){

  function featureKey(f){
    const c=f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates;
    if(!c)return Math.random().toString();
    let p=null;
    if(f.geometry.type==="LineString"&&c.length)p=c[Math.floor(c.length/2)];
    else if(f.geometry.type==="Polygon"&&c[0]&&c[0].length)p=c[0][Math.floor(c[0].length/2)];
    return p?p.map(v=>Number(v).toFixed(5)).join("|"):JSON.stringify(c).slice(0,120);
  }

    const features=[],raw=[],candidates=[];

    for(let y=3;y<GH-3;y+=3)for(let x=3;x<GW-3;x+=3){
      const i=idx(x,y);

      if((M.acc[i]||0)>=channelThreshold)continue;

  function gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,gx,gy){
    const dxM=(gx-GW/2)*cellM,dyM=(gy-GH/2)*cellM;

  function featureKey(f){
    const c=f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates;
    if(!c)return Math.random().toString();
    let p=null;
    if(f.geometry.type==="LineString"&&c.length)p=c[Math.floor(c.length/2)];
    else if(f.geometry.type==="Polygon"&&c[0]&&c[0].length)p=c[0][Math.floor(c[0].length/2)];
    return p?p.map(v=>Number(v).toFixed(5)).join("|"):JSON.stringify(c).slice(0,120);
  }
  function appendUnique(target,features){

  }
  function regionalOpportunitySwales15773(tile,cellM,tileIndex,opportunity){
    const features=[],raw=[],candidates=[];
    const maxAcc=Math.max(2,Number(M.maxAcc||2));
    const channelThreshold=Math.max(3,streamThreshold()*3.0);

    for(let y=3;y<GH-3;y+=3)for(let x=3;x<GW-3;x+=3){
      const i=idx(x,y);
      if(!M.inP[i]||M.pond[i]||(M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i]))continue;
      if((M.acc[i]||0)>=channelThreshold)continue;
      const sp=slopePct(x,y);
      if(sp<2.2||sp>6.5)continue;
      const slopeFit=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(sp-3.5)/3.0);
      const runoff=Math.log1p(M.acc[i]||1)/Math.log1p(maxAcc);
      const open=(M.canopyMask&&M.canopyMask[i])?0.25:1;
      const score=.50*slopeFit+.34*runoff+.16*open;
      candidates.push({x,y,sp,score,L:hAt(x,y)});
    }
    candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);

    const acceptedLevels=[];
    for(const c of candidates){
      if(features.length>=4)break;
      if(acceptedLevels.some(L=>Math.abs(L-c.L)<Math.max(.25,cellM*.018)))continue;

      const pts=traceLevelContour(c.x,c.y,c.L,12,Math.max(.12,cellM*.02));
      if(!pts||pts.length<4)continue;

      const split=earthlineSplitUsableSegments(pts,12);
      let bestSeg=null,bestLen=0;
      for(const seg of (split||[])){
        const len=earthlineSegmentLengthM(seg);
        if(len>bestLen){bestLen=len;bestSeg=seg;}
      }
      if(!bestSeg||bestLen<Math.max(35,cellM*3))continue;

      const display=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(bestSeg);
      const safeParts=earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(display,12);
      for(const safe of safeParts){
        const lenM=earthlinePathLengthM(safe);
        if(!safe||safe.length<3||lenM<Math.max(30,cellM*2.5))continue;
        const coords=safe.map(p=>gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,p[0],p[1]));
        const id="O"+tileIndex+"-"+(features.length+1);
        const score=Math.round(100*(.65*c.score+.35*Math.min(1,Number(opportunity&&opportunity.score||0)/100)));
        features.push({
          type:"Feature",
          properties:{
            id,tile:tileIndex,score,
            scale:"regional-opportunity",
            constructionReady:false,
            label:"GRADED SWALE OPPORTUNITY"
          },
          geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:coords}
        });
        raw.push({
          tile:tileIndex,id,coords,lenM,capCells:Math.max(1,M.acc[idx(Math.round(c.x),Math.round(c.y))]||1),
    
nst feature=index>=0?all[index]:rendered;
        if(typeof window.earthlineOpenCorridorDetail16149==='function')window.earthlineOpenCorridorDetail16149(feature,index>=0?index:0);
      };

  function gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,gx,gy){
    const dxM=(gx-GW/2)*cellM,dyM=(gy-GH/2)*cellM;
    return [tile.lng+dxM/metersPerLng(tile.lat),tile.lat-dyM/111320];
  }
  function featureKey(f){
    const c=f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates;
    if(!c)return Math.random().toString();
    let p=null;
    if(f.geometry.type==="LineString"&&c.length)p=c[Math.floor(c.length/2)];
    else if(f.geometry.type==="Polygon"&&c[0]&&c[0].length)p=c[0][Math.floor(c[0].length/2)];
    return p?p.map(v=>Number(v).toFixed(5)).join("|"):JSON.stringify(c).slice(0,120);
  }
  function appendUnique(target,features){
    const keys=new Set(target.map(featureKey));
    for(const f of (features||[])){const k=featureKey(f);if(keys.has(k))continue;keys.add(k);target.push(f);}
  }
  function regionalOpportunitySwales15773(tile,cellM,tileIndex,opportunity){
    const features=[],raw=[],candidates=[];
    const maxAcc=Math.max(2,Number(M.maxAcc||2));
    const channelThreshold=Math.max(3,streamThreshold()*3.0);

    for(let y=3;y<GH-3;y+=3)for(let x=3;x<GW-3;x+=3){
      const i=idx(x,y);
      if(!M.inP[i]||M.pond[i]||(M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i]))continue;
      if((M.acc[i]||0)>=channelThreshold)continue;
      const sp=slopePct(x,y);
      if(sp<2.2||sp>6.5)continue;
      const slopeFit=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(sp-3.5)/3.0);
      const runoff=Math.log1p(M.acc[i]||1)/Math.log1p(maxAcc);
      const open=(M.canopyMask&&M.canopyMask[i])?0.25:1;
      const score=.50*slopeFit+.34*runoff+.16*open;
      candidates.push({x,y,sp,score,L:hAt(x,y)});
    }
    candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);

    const acceptedLevels=[];
    for(const c of candidates){
      if(features.length>=4)break;
      if(acceptedLevels.some(L=>Math.abs(L-c.L)<Math.max(.25,cellM*.018)))continue;

      const pts=traceLevelContour(c.x,c.y,c.L,12,Math.max(.12,cellM*.02));
      if(!pts||pts.length<4)continue;

      const split=earthlineSplitUsableSegments(pts,12);
      let bestSeg=null,bestLen=0;
      for(const seg of (split||[])){
        const len=earthlineSegmentLengthM(seg);
        if(len>bestLen){bestLen=len;bestSeg=seg;}
      }
      if(!bestSeg||bestLen<Math.max(35,cellM*3))continue;

      const display=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(bestSeg);
      const safeParts=earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(display,12);
      for(const safe of safeParts){
        const lenM=earthlinePathLengthM(safe);
        if(!safe||safe.length<3||lenM<Math.max(30,cellM*2.5))continue;
        const coords=safe.map(p=>gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,p[0],p[1]));
        const id="O"+tileIndex+"-"+(features.length+1);
        const score=Math.round(100*(.65*c.score+.35*Math.min(1,Number(opportunity&&opportunity.score||0)/100)));
        features.push({
          type:"Feature",
          properties:{
            id,tile:tileIndex,score,
            scale:"regional-opportunity",
            constructionReady:false,
            label:"GRADED SWALE OPPORTUNITY"
          },
          geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:coords}
        });
        raw.push({
          tile:tileIndex,id,coords,lenM,capCells:Math.max(1,M.acc[idx(Math.round(c.x),Math.round(c.y))]||1),
          score,bandKey:String(tileIndex)+"|O"+acceptedLevels.length,
          absLevelM:Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+c.L
        });
        acceptedLevels.push(c.L);
        break;
      }
    }
    return {features,raw};
  }

  let enforcing=false;

  function keepFirst15784(nodes,preferred){
    const list=[...nodes];
    if(list.length<=1)return list[0]||null;
    let keep=null;
    if(preferred){
      const root=document.querySelector(preferred);
      if(root)keep=list.find(el=>root.contains(el))||null;
    }
    keep=keep||list[0];
    for(const el of list){
      if(el!==keep&&el&&el.parentNode)el.remove();
    }
    return keep;
  }

    return keepFirst15784(document.querySelectorAll('[id="'+id+'"]'),preferred);
  }

  const metersPerLng=lat=>111320*Math.max(.05,Math.cos(Number(lat||0)*Math.PI/180));
  const coordDistanceM=(a,b)=>{
    const lat=(Number(a[1])+Number(b[1]))*.5;
    return Math.hypot((Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*metersPerLng(lat),(Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*111320);
  };
  const lineLengthM=coords=>{
    let d=0;for(let i=1;i<(coords||[]).length;i++)d+=coordDistanceM(coords[i-1],coords[i]);return d;
  };
  const pointSegmentDistanceM=(p,a,b)=>{
    const lat=Number(p[1]);
    const ax=(Number(a[0])-Number(p[0]))*metersPerLng(lat),ay=(Number(a[1])-lat)*111320;
    const bx=(Number(b[0])-Number(p[0]))*metersPerLng(lat),by=(Number(b[1])-lat)*111320;
    const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,den=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    const t=den?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-(ax*dx+ay*dy)/den)):0;
    return Math.hypot(ax+t*dx,ay+t*dy);
  };
  const pointInRing=(p,ring)=>{
    let inside=false;
    for(let i=0,j=(ring||[]).length-1;i<(ring||[]).length;j=i++){
      const xi=Number(ring[i][0]),yi=Number(ring[i][1]);
      const xj=Number(ring[j][0]),yj=Number(ring[j][1]);
      if(((yi>p[1])!==(yj>p[1]))&&(p[0]<(xj-xi)*(p[1]-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-12)+xi))inside=!inside;
    }
    return inside;
  };
  const ringDistanceM=(p,ring)=>{
    let best=Infinity;
    for(let i=1;i<(ring||[]).length;i++)best=Math.min(best,pointSegmentDistanceM(p,ring[i-1],ring[i]));
    if(ring&&ring.length>2)best=Math.min(best,pointSegmentDistanceM(p,ring[ring.length-1],ring[0]));
    return best;
  };
  const safeCoord=c=>Array.isArray(c)&&Number.isFinite(Number(c[0]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(c[1]));

  function featureTag(f){
    const p=f&&f.properties||{},l=f&&f.layer||{};
    return [l.id,l.type,f&&f.sourceLayer,l["source-layer"],p.class,p.type,p.structure,p.maki,p.category,p.kind,p.landuse,p.name]
      .filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
  }
  function featureClass(f){
    const tag=featureTag(f),type=String(f&&f.layer&&f.layer.type||"").toLowerCase();
    const water=/river|stream|canal|waterway|water|lake|reservoir|wetland|drain|ditch/.test(tag);
    const structure=type==="fill-extrusion"||/building|structure|house|roof|address/.test(tag);
    const developed=/residential|commercial|industrial|retail|institution|school|hospital|airport|parking/.test(tag);
    const road=/road|street|motorway|trunk|primary|secondary|tertiary|residential|service|drive|driveway|track|path|bridge|tunnel|transportation|rail/.test(tag);
    if(water)return "water";
    if(structure)return "structure";
    if(road)return "road";
    if(developed)return "developed";
    return "";
  }
  function bufferForFeature(f,kind){
    const tag=featureTag(f);
    if(kind==="water")return /river|lake|reservoir/.test(tag)?22:/stream|canal|waterway/.test(tag)?14:16;
    if(kind==="structure")return 12;
    if(kind==="developed")return 8;
    if(/motorway|trunk|primary/.test(tag))return 18;
    if(/secondary|tertiary|rail/.test(tag))return 14;
    if(/service|drive|driveway|track|path/.test(tag))return 9;
    return 11;
  }

  function bbox15788(coords){
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
    for(const c of coords||[]){if(!safeCoord(c))continue;const x=Number(c[0]),y=Number(c[1]);if(x<minX)minX=x;if(x>maxX)maxX=x;if(y<minY)minY=y;if(y>maxY)maxY=y;}
    return Number.isFinite(minX)?{minX,minY,maxX,maxY}:null;
  }
  function bboxLowerBoundM15788(coord,bbox){
    if(!safeCoord(coord)||!bbox)return 0;
    const lon=Number(coord[0]),lat=Number(coord[1]);
    const dxDeg=lon<bbox.minX?bbox.minX-lon:(lon>bbox.maxX?lon-bbox.maxX:0);
    const dyDeg=lat<bbox.minY?bbox.minY-lat:(lat>bbox.maxY?lat-bbox.maxY:0);
    // Conservative lower bound: never skips geometry that could satisfy an existing buffer.
    const maxAbsLat=Math.max(Math.abs(lat),Math.abs(bbox.minY),Math.abs(bbox.maxY));
    const lngM=111320*Math.max(.001,Math.cos(Math.min(89.999,maxAbsLat)*Math.PI/180));
    return Math.hypot(dxDeg*lngM,dyDeg*111320);
  }

  function safeData(data){
    if(data&&data.type==="FeatureCollection"&&Array.isArray(data.features))return data;
    if(typeof data==="string"){
      try{const parsed=JSON.parse(data);if(parsed&&parsed.type==="FeatureCollection")return parsed;}catch(e){}
    }
    return emptyFC();
  }
