  function valleyPoint15792(x,y,d){
    if(d<0)return [x+.5,y+.5];
    const vx=D8X[d],vy=D8Y[d],mag=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1,px=-vy/mag,py=vx/mag;
    let best=[x+.5,y+.5],bestH=hAt(best[0],best[1]);
    for(const off of [-.42,-.24,0,.24,.42]){
      const q=[x+.5+px*off,y+.5+py*off],hh=hAt(q[0],q[1]);
      if(hh<bestH){bestH=hh;best=q;}
    }
    return best;
  }

  function earthlineAuthoritativeFlowGeoJSON15823(){
    let primary=emptyFC();
    try{primary=safeData(flowGeoJSON15792())}catch(e){}
    if(primary.features.length){
      M.propertyFlowGeneration15823={
        build:"BUILD-CHECK-15823",
        method:"flowGeoJSON15792",
        primaryFeatures:primary.features.length,
        fallbackFeatures:0,
        generatedAt:Date.now()
      };
      return primary;
    }

    const fallback=earthlineFallbackFlowGeoJSON15823();
    M.propertyFlowGeneration15823={
      build:"BUILD-CHECK-15823",
      method:"D8-fallback-renderer",
      primaryFeatures:0,
      fallbackFeatures:fallback.features.length,
      generatedAt:Date.now()
    };
    return fallback;
  }

  function scheduleRehydrate15799(reason="unspecified"){
    // A new request supersedes pending rehydration work. The previous implementation
    // scheduled seven timers on every styledata and idle event; animated paint changes
    // could therefore generate an unbounded event/timer storm.

    const delays=[0,90,280,760,1600];

      rehydrateTimers15799.add(timer);
    }
    return true;

  const coordDistanceM=(a,b)=>{
    const lat=(Number(a[1])+Number(b[1]))*.5*Math.PI/180;
    const dx=(Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*111320*Math.max(.05,Math.cos(lat));
    const dy=(Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*110540;
    return Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  };
  function hash15806(a,b,c){
    const x=Math.sin((a+1)*12.9898+(b+1)*78.233+(c+1)*37.719)*43758.5453;
    return x-Math.floor(x);
  }
  function offsetCoord15806(coord,tangent,offsetM){
    const lat=Number(coord[1])*Math.PI/180;
    const nx=-Number(tangent[1]),ny=Number(tangent[0]);
    const norm=Math.hypot(nx,ny)||1;
    const east=nx/norm*offsetM,north=ny/norm*offsetM;
    return [
      Number(coord[0])+east/(111320*Math.max(.05,Math.cos(lat))),
      Number(coord[1])+north/110540
    ];
  }
  function plantingPoints15806(fc){
    const features=[];
    for(let fi=0;fi<(fc.features||[]).length;fi++){
      const line=fc.features[fi];
      const coords=line&&line.geometry&&line.geometry.type==="LineString"
        ?line.geometry.coordinates.filter(finiteCoord):[];
      let walked=0,next=5+hash15806(fi,0,0)*4,plantIndex=0;
      for(let i=1;i<coords.length;i++){
        const a=coords[i-1],b=coords[i],segment=coordDistanceM(a,b);
        if(segment<=0)continue;
        while(walked+segment>=next){
          const t=(next-walked)/segment;
          const point=[
            Number(a[0])+(Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*t,
            Number(a[1])+(Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*t
          ];
          const lat=point[1]*Math.PI/180;
          const tangent=[
            (Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*111320*Math.max(.05,Math.cos(lat)),
            (Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*110540
          ];
          for(const side of [-1,1]){
            const jitter=(hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+2)-.5)*.8;
            const offset=side*(1.05+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+8)*1.25)+jitter;
            const palette=Math.floor(hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+15)*5);
            features.push({
              type:"Feature",
              properties:{
                corridorId:String(line.properties&&line.properties.id||fi+1),
                palette,
                size:Number((2.6+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+21)*2.8).toFixed(2))
              },
              geometry:{type:"Point",coordinates:offsetCoord15806(point,tangent,offset)}
            });
          }
          plantIndex++;
          next+=6.5+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,5)*6.5;
        }
        walked+=segment;
      }
    }
    return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
  }

  function safetyPanel15806(){
    let el=document.getElementById("earthlineSafetyAudit15806");
    if(!el){
      const host=document.getElementById("cCount")&&document.getElementById("cCount").closest(".panel");
      if(host){el=document.createElement("div");el.id="earthlineSafetyAudit15806";host.appendChild(el)}
    }
    if(!el)return null;

    const audit=M&&M.safetyAudit15806||null;
    if(!audit){
      el.className="warn";
      el.innerHTML=
        "<strong>SAFETY SCREENING NOT YET RUN</strong>"+
        "Run the property analysis to screen the available road, structure and "+
        "waterway data. Field verification will still be required.";
      return el;
    }

    const clearance=audit.clearance||{};
    const filter=audit.filter||{};
    const verified=!!audit.verified;
    const rawIntersectionValue=Number(audit.acceptedIntersections);
    const detected=Number.isFinite(rawIntersectionValue)
      ?Math.max(0,rawIntersectionValue):0;

    const stateText=!verified
      ?"NOT VERIFIED — "+detected+
        " INTERSECTION"+(detected===1?"":"S")+
        " DETECTED IN AVAILABLE DATA; COVERAGE INCOMPLETE. "+
        "FIELD VERIFICATION REQUIRED."
      :detected>0
        ?"SCREENING FLAG — "+detected+
          " INTERSECTION"+(detected===1?"":"S")+
          " DETECTED IN AVAILABLE DATA. AFFECTED SEGMENTS WITHHELD; "+
          "FIELD VERIFICATION REQUIRED."
        :"SCREENED — 0 INTERSECTIONS DETECTED IN AVAILABLE DATA. "+
          "THIS IS NOT A CONSTRUCTION-SAFETY PASS; FIELD VERIFICATION REQUIRED.";

    el.className=detected>0?"fail":"warn";
    const safeSegments=Number(
      clearance.safeSegments!=null
        ?clearance.safeSegments
        :(
          audit.safeSegments!=null
            ?audit.safeSegments
            :filter.outputSegments||0
        )
    );

    el.innerHTML=
      "<strong>"+stateText+"</strong>"+
      '<div class="safety-grid">'+
      "<span>Raw modeled segments</span><span class=value>"+Number(audit.rawSegments||0)+"</span>"+
      "<span>Safety-screened segments</span><span class=value>"+safeSegments+"</span>"+
      "<span>Clipped / removed</span><span class=value>"+Number(filter.clippedCandidates||0)+" / "+Number(filter.removedCandidates||0)+"</span>"+
      "<span>Detected intersections</span><span class=value>"+detected+"</span>"+
      "<span>Exclusion-data coverage</span><span class=value>"+(verified?"Available index":"Incomplete")+"</span>"+
      "</div>";
    return el;
  }
  function ensureContoursButton15806(){
    const host=document.querySelector(".center");if(!host)return null;
    let button=document.getElementById("earthlineSwalesContours15806");
    if(!bu
.length;fi++){
      const line=fc.features[fi];
      const coords=line&&line.geometry&&line.geometry.type==="LineString"
        ?line.geometry.coordinates.filter(finiteCoord):[];
      let walked=0,next=5+hash15806(fi,0,0)*4,plantIndex=0;
      for(let i=1;i<coords.length;i++){
        const a=coords[i-1],b=coords[i],segment=coordDistanceM(a,b);
        if(segment<=0)continue;
        while(walked+segment>=next){
          const t=(next-walked)/segment;
          const point=[
            Number(a[0])+(Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*t,
            Number(a[1])+(Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*t
          ];
          const lat=point[1]*Math.PI/180;
          const tangent=[
            (Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*111320*Math.max(.05,Math.cos(lat)),
            (Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*110540
          ];
          for(const side of [-1,1]){
            const jitter=(hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+2)-.5)*.8;
            const offset=side*(1.05+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+8)*1.25)+jitter;
            const palette=Math.floor(hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+15)*5);
            features.push({
              type:"Feature",
              properties:{
                corridorId:String(line.properties&&line.properties.id||fi+1),
                palette,
                size:Number((2.6+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,side+21)*2.8).toFixed(2))
              },
              geometry:{type:"Point",coordinates:offsetCoord15806(point,tangent,offset)}
            });
          }
          plantIndex++;
          next+=6.5+hash15806(fi,plantIndex,5)*6.5;
        }
        walked+=segment;
      }
    }
    return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
  }

  function mercatorXY(p){const R=6378137,lon=Number(p?.[0])||0,lat=Math.max(-85,Math.min(85,Number(p?.[1])||0))*Math.PI/180;return [R*lon*Math.PI/180,R*Math.log(Math.tan(Math.PI/4+lat/2))]}
  function mercatorLL(p){const R=6378137;return [Number(p?.[0]||0)/R*180/Math.PI,(2*Math.atan(Math.exp(Number(p?.[1]||0)/R))-Math.PI/2)*180/Math.PI]}
  function unit(x,y){const m=Math.hypot(x,y)||1;return [x/m,y/m]}
  function bufferedRing(coords,halfWidth=4.5){if(!Array.isArray(coords)||coords.length<2)return null;const xy=coords.map(mercatorXY),left=[],right=[];for(let i=0;i<xy.length;i++){const prev=xy[Math.max(0,i-1)],cur=xy[i],next=xy[Math.min(xy.length-1,i+1)],d1=unit(cur[0]-prev[0],cur[1]-prev[1]),d2=unit(next[0]-cur[0],next[1]-cur[1]);let tx=d1[0]+d2[0],ty=d1[1]+d2[1];if(Math.hypot(tx,ty)<.001){tx=d2[0]||d1[0];ty=d2[1]||d1[1]}const t=unit(tx,ty),n=[-t[1],t[0]],n1=[-d1[1],d1[0]],den=Math.max(.28,Math.abs(n[0]*n1[0]+n[1]*n1[1])),m=Math.min(halfWidth*2.4,halfWidth/den);left.push(mercatorLL([cur[0]+n[0]*m,cur[1]+n[1]*m]));right.push(mercatorLL([cur[0]-n[0]*m,cur[1]-n[1]*m]))}const ring=[...left,...right.reverse()];if(ring.length<4)return null;ring.push(ring[0]);return ring}
